nom: The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Light Facial Cleansing Oil

segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally describe the oil as lightweight and non-greasy, though one reports it clogs pores and worsens acne while several others say it did not irritate or break them out.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one with eczema, report the oil relieves dryness and tightness without irritation, and one uses it specifically on colder, drier days.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say the product caused no reaction, dryness, or breakouts, but others with sensitivity flag the fragrance as a drawback or report eye irritation.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing normal-to-dry skin says the product cleans without over-stripping and works well for her.
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the oil works well, feels lightweight rather than greasy, and one specifically credits it (with jojoba oil) as suited to oily/combination skin.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers across skin types say the oil leaves skin hydrated, moisturized, and not tight or stripped after rinsing; no reviewer reports increased dryness.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers mention irritation or eye burning/itching after use, while many others with sensitive or reactive skin report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle and non-stripping, with several noting no tightness or compromised feel post-cleanse; no barrier damage is reported.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes the rice-based formula is said to help prevent the appearance of spots, and several mention clearer, brighter-looking skin, though this is not tied to a specific active claim by most.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report clearer skin, faster healing, or no new breakouts, but one combination/acne-prone reviewer reports clogged pores and a con for acne, and another mentions a concern about new spots appearing.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the product itself as lightweight and non-greasy, and several with oily skin say it does not leave a shiny or oily residue after rinsing.

aspects.libelle: Effective on waterproof makeup and mascara
Requires double cleanse to feel fully clean

extraits.texte: I have combo skin that is prone to acne. This cleansing oil smells great, but heavy fragrance is often not recommended for skincare. Pro- this is an okay oil for massaging black heads out. Cons- It could be a user error, but I dislike how the oil does a mid job of removing my waterproof makeup, doesn't fully emulsify, and clogs my pores. I hope it works for you, but I would not recommend purchasing this.

I live in a dry and seasonally cold climate. It's so nice to be able to swap out my normal face wash for this on days where my skin is feeling extra dry. It didn't leave my skin feeling oily or unclean, but I would recommend putting it on a clean face versus using it to clean off makeup. But that's just become my personal preference. Oh, I also have eczema and it doesn't cause any irritation and the mild rose smell is amazing!

extraits.titre: Lightweight, leaving soft and perfect for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This is the great oil cleansing removal for sensitive skin. The oil does not have a scent and I have not had any issues with my sensitive skin. This has an extremely thin, liquidy texture, it is almost like water. It left my face all soft and with a fresh feeling, oil is very lightweight and does not leave any residue. Highly recommend!!!

I used this product as the first step in my double cleanse routine-maiky to remove make-up. I was pleasantly surprised with how well and easily it melted my make up off with minimal rubbing! I even wore waterproof mascara one evening, and had no issues removing with this product. The only drawback is the added fragrance- it is soft but noticable. I would like to see this product in a more "sensitive" version for people like me who would usually avoid fragrance in their skin care products. I never had any breakouts or additional acne when using this product, I am really happy and will be purchasing another bottle once I am out. 🙂

I have very sensitive skin and tend to break out if I use something my skin doesn't like but this has been wonderful! I used to have very noticeable pores especially on my nose and blackheads but this cleared them up in one wash. One month later and my pores are hardly visible, my face feels smooth, and this hasn't dried out my skin at all. I'm half way through my bottle and plan to keep buying it!

I love this cleansing oil. I have acne prone skin and usually oils make my face worse but this one is so light and doesn't clog my pores. It's great for heavy and light makeup and really removes everything thoroughly. I usually massage my face for 4 minutes when using this since I use the 424 method of cleansing and so as I'm removing makeup I'm also helping my face with blood circulation. When using this product, make sure to do it on dry face because it turns a milky texture when it comes in contact with water.
I have super sensitive skin and typically react to new products but not with this product which was a super plus.
